summary: The manuscript presents a rigorous zero-dependency Lean 4 formalization and pure-stdlib verifier (TAPE-MUL-CERT-1.0) for the exact algebraic, spectral, CRT, and unpaid-entropy components of multitape integer multiplication complexity. All 18 Lean theorems verify with zero sorries, and 16 exact-Z/Q certificates successfully pass zero-float replay.
weaknesses: Scope boundaries restrict formalization to algebraic and entropy barrier components rather than a full Turing-machine simulator or recursive block-transposition schedules.
